APPROVE

The extractions (`WorkspaceDirsByName`, `TransitiveWorkspaceDeps`, `ChangeFilterSite`, `IsUnder`) preserve the original logic and the inverted `reported.Add` check is equivalent to the old `continue`. Removing the nested `foreach`/`while`/`if` blocks should bring the method's complexity well under 15. I could not compile it or check the helper parameter types (`JsInventory.Inventory`, `CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation`) against the rest of the file.
